items.title: Ohana names Erling Haaland as a homeowner at Manchester City Yas Residences
items.summary: Ohana used a celebrity buyer announcement to promote Phase 2 of its football-branded community on Yas Island.

items.title: Nakheel unveils Bay Estate, a gated waterfront community on Dubai Islands
items.summary: About 360 villas and townhouses across three districts (Cala, Verda, Agora) on a 653,709 sq m masterplan with 2.4 km of beachfront and a yacht marina.

items.project: Bab Al Qasr Beach Resort Residence 77
items.title: Burtville launches beachfront Residence 77 on Al Reem Island
items.summary: Furnished freehold homes from 1 to 5 bedrooms plus duplexes; about 92% with direct sea views. Handover Q4 2031.

items.title: Aldar and Arada sign Dh15bn partnership for new Abu Dhabi communities
items.summary: Joint venture for a villa and townhouse community of up to 1.5M sqm on the Abu Dhabi–Dubai border; Arada also bought three residential plots on Yas Island. Marks Arada's entry into Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Aldar's Yas Riva Reserve and Talay drive more than Dh5bn in sales
items.summary: Gated community of 292 villas (4–6 BR). Combined sales with Talay exceeded Dh5bn; UAE nationals were 31% of buyers.

items.title: Aldar launches Talay, first homes at Marsa Al Saadiyat
items.summary: 351 standalone villas (4–6 BR); sales opened 23 Sep. Reported starting prices range AED 12.6M–13.5M.

items.title: Aldar announces Sei Saadiyat in the Cultural District
items.summary: 778 apartments and lofts across six buildings; first phase of 265 homes on a 50/50 plan with 5% down. Handover Q4 2030.

items.project: Wynn Al Marjan Island – Royal Apartments
items.title: Wynn Al Marjan Island details two 7-bedroom Royal Apartments
items.summary: Two ~1,460 sqm apartments on the top floors of the 70-storey tower; resort opens 2027.

items.title: Bloom Holding launches Alhambra, final phase of Bloom Living
items.summary: Studios to 3BR apartments, 3BR townhouses and limited 4BR penthouses in a low-rise Spanish-style gated community.

items.project: Wynn Al Marjan Island – Enclave Townhomes
items.title: Wynn adds four private townhomes at its Ras Al Khaimah resort
items.summary: 2BR and 4BR two-level townhomes (630–1,110 sqm) with private courtyards and plunge pools.

items.title: Emaar to unveil Dh200bn masterplan for 150,000 residents
items.summary: 4.5M+ sqm GFA across five zones including towers, villas and mansions, following 20-minute-city principles.
